violations.text: Refrigerator door gaskets for 3 door reach in were observed in poor repair. Shelving also missing mounting hook for top left shelf. Equipment to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 12/15/2026

The food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils were not sanitized. The required utensil surface temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit was not achieved during the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher as evidenced by the failure of the thermolabel (temperature indicator) affixed to the surface of a utensil to turn black. Establishment to use disposable single service ware until dishmachine is properly adjusted and in good repair. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2026

Dishmachine was not in good repair. The digital display of machine read 116 degrees Fahrenheit for the final rinse cycle prior and after emptying and refilling machine. Establishment does not have a 3 bay sink. All dishes and utensils to be single service ware until dishmachine is properly adjusted. Proof of repairs to be sent to inspector. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026
